status: Exploratory plan. It changes no registered result or counter, makes no identification claim and plans no travel. Every stop rule is PROPOSED; the project owner decides.

analogues.label: EVIDENCE
analogues.lesson: Rate each objective before digging, so that expectations stay honest and the rating decides where to dig.
analogues.source: University of Leicester, 'Where to dig' (https://le.ac.uk/richard-iii/discovery/where-to-dig), read 9 October 2026 through a web reader; a direct download returned HTTP 403, so no SHA-256 of the page is recorded. Five objectives, from 'a reasonable expectation' to 'not seriously considered possible'; about 17% of the precinct was accessible and about 1% could be dug. Buckley et al. 2013, Antiquity 87: 519-538 (doi:10.1017/S0003598X00049103), p. 521: finding the grave 'seemed improbable if not impossible'; PDF SHA-256 3d8c7e844c02c057d79da220d489f451aeede0a7cbb5d68bead2d10fc35e6cf8.

analogues.label: EVIDENCE
analogues.lesson: Produce intermediate results that justify the next grant.
analogues.source: J. T. Wood 1877, Discoveries at Ephesus, Introduction pp. vii-viii (the Trustees wanted 'some substantial return'; the Odeum and Theatre came first; a fresh grant in 1867; the inscribed peribolus wall corner in 1869 released sufficient funds) and chapter VI summary p. 111 (Magnesian Gate, road to the temple, supplementary grant, peribolos wall). archive.org item discoveriesateph00wood, OCR text SHA-256 4b29539ae858dba930453e36b103d9cd27e491fd76487ba0ed6919c3aab29f87.

stages.name: Reserved observation in hand
stages.definition: An outside observation that can decide a registered alternative arrives and passes the authentication or registration gate frozen before it was seen.

rating_evidence.claim: Three independent routes to an image of XII 10 at the 21/22 cut are open: USC masters (20 records), Manchester Museum and Joan Taylor (Allegro C.21-23), and the EDF copy and X-rays at the ÉBAF. Facsimile Editions declined.
The XII 10 reading protocol has a frozen authentication gate.
The Mosaic Centre will scan Meinardus 1965-66 free of charge in mid-October; those pages are the stated reopen criterion of the closed St Andrew branch.
Pre-camp records north of Tell es-Sultan have a registration protocol with a withheld check point.

stages.pays_for: Reading sessions under the frozen protocol, and a request for control frames from the same image series.
stages.analogue: Greyfriars objective 1, find the friary: 'a reasonable expectation'. Wood: the Odeum and Theatre gave the first return.

stages.name: Disputed reading settled by an outside observation
stages.definition: That observation rejects, or supports relative to the registered alternatives, at least one registered reading under a frozen protocol (for example one of the XII 10 strings R1-R7).

rating_evidence.claim: A decisive XII 10 reading alone guarantees that the seven strings separate; bet against kaf, or the extra stroke, can each reject R4 without the cut letter.
The 0.15 mm saw cut cannot hide a whole yod or waw.
Against: from copy plates an AI reader scored 8 of 16 on bet/kaf and 7 of 16 on he/ḥet, which is chance; Lefkovits 2000 p. 78 calls many letters indistinguishable.
Against: the protocol returns 'not identifiable' for disagreement, inadequate resolution or unresolved damage, and the earlier original-photo reading audit of entries 31, 40 and 49 ended that way.

stages.pays_for: A narrower set of Koḥlit classes, so the next archive or library request goes to a record that can still separate the survivors.
stages.analogue: Wood read the Salutaris inscription in the theatre and found the Magnesian Gate from it. Greyfriars objective 2: 'a probability'.

stages.name: One branch decided on measured ground
stages.definition: A frozen branch-level test of one relation or location instruction at one candidate, using a dated contact or a surveyed datum, ends 'supported relative to the registered alternatives' or 'rejected', not 'not identifiable'. A rejection is a conditional model exclusion, not a site rejection.

rating_evidence.claim: Precedent: two conditional model exclusions are registered, both at Siloam L103.
The Kenyon eastern section can exclude four quarry-pit Koḥlit classes; Kallai pp. 172-173 can exclude four; a dated IV/17 wall or mouth contact separates 12 of 15 entry 25 pairs.
Against: every queued record can return an inconclusive result, and the Kenyon plates and Kallai pages are neither requested nor obtained.
Against: the three formal assessments are all inconclusive, and every closed test ended 'not identifiable from available evidence'.
Against: only 11 of 28 next chain links can contradict their model outright.

stages.pays_for: The next link in that model's chain, and if the owner agrees, an archive order for the record that would decide the next relation.
stages.analogue: Wood followed the road from the Magnesian Gate. Greyfriars objective 3, locate the church: 'a possibility'.

stages.name: One landmark independently discriminated
stages.definition: The ledger counter for independently discriminated identifications moves from 0 to 1: a source-supported reading, observed feature relations, the relevant phase and a justified datum distinguish the candidate from its controls, and a registered unseen prediction succeeds.

rating_evidence.claim: The counter is 0, and identification needs discrimination plus a registered unseen prediction.
Rarity is not measurable: k = 0, f = 20, m = 313 of 333 after the source-2 addendum.
Every FAIL in that count rests on a site-level absence covering at most about 1.1% of the 1 km northern sector; under scope rules f = 0 in every row.
At best the queue narrows Koḥlit to one class, the Jericho historical basin with NS1 or D9; a roster is a selected set, so separating it identifies nothing.
The regional unexcavated-alternative inventory and search coverage are not audited.

stages.pays_for: Only then a request for a field observation at the target, which the owner alone would decide.
stages.analogue: Wood's inscribed peribolus wall fixed the precinct. Greyfriars objective 4, locate the choir: 'an outside chance'.

stages.name: Phase-to-instruction match at that landmark
stages.definition: At a discriminated landmark, the feature that the instruction names is dated to a phase when the instruction was usable; that phase's surface gives the datum, and the instruction's target volume is computed from it.

rating_evidence.claim: None of the four target-coverage records has a defined target geometry.
IV/17: 8 of 8 target branches are undeterminable without the L-656 file; Tell es-Sultan: 4 of 4 joins are undeterminable because entry 60 gives no distance.
An ancient threshold can make a target computable but separates no class.
R09, which asks for feature-level phase records, is still queued.

stages.pays_for: A check of whether any recorded excavation reached that volume, using the six coverage gates.
stages.analogue: Greyfriars: within the choir, the grave position. Strictly harder than S4, so rated no higher.

stages.name: Deposit location
stages.definition: A deposit location confirmed, or a negative excavation verified at a predicted target volume.

rating_evidence.claim: Confirmed deposit locations: 0; verified negative excavations at predicted targets: 0.
A landmark match proves neither a deposit nor the whole account; a negative excavation needs target volume, phase, reach, disturbance and detection limits.
The project plans no excavation, and the owner declined trip planning on 8 October (status note outside the repository; recorded in this folder's README).

stages.analogue: Greyfriars objective 5, the king: 'not seriously considered possible'.

states.waiting: A request is pending; no sessions until the item arrives.
states.active: Sessions can be spent now on an item in hand or open access.
states.park: No sessions until the resume observation arrives.
states.run_once: One frozen run, then the lane closes.
states.integrate: A tool built this round; one integration session, then its stop rule applies.

rules.text: A closed test reopens only for its stated new observation or a documented analytical error; the previous result is preserved. A stop rule here never reopens or closes a test.
PROPOSED: A parked lane resumes only when its named resume observation arrives. Parking a lane is not a test result.

PROPOSED (Wood): Spend a new outreach message, a library item or any money on a lane only for its first observation, or after its last result met its continue-if condition. Money always needs the owner's approval.
PROPOSED (Greyfriars): Each new request names the stage and rating it serves. A request that serves only a C or D stage needs the owner's explicit approval.
